A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DreamCatalyst and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices. Corresponding content can be matched despite renumbering and added supplementary evaluations.

before.justification: v2 reports original NeRF and 3DGS experiments, component ablations and a 100-participant user study in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds convergence comparisons and experiments applying FreeU to PDS.

M1.justification: The weighted DDS objective, identity regularizer, weighting functions, decreasing timestep schedule, IP2P backbone and FreeU integration are unchanged. The added explanations and PDS experiments do not modify DreamCatalyst's procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate eight scenes with 40 source/target prompt pairs across NeRF and 3DGS, with the same user-study coverage. The added appendix comparisons use existing scene types and editing tasks.

E2.justification: v3 adds PDS with FreeU as an evaluated comparison variant in Table 5 and Figure 13. The established NeRF and 3DGS comparator sets remain unchanged; Figure 7 supplies additional illustrations from the already compared PDS method.

E3.justification: The new convergence evaluation measures CLIP directional similarity and visual outputs at intermediate optimization iterations (Figures 12 and 14). The added PDS control uses FreeU with b = 1.1. Existing benchmark budgets, metrics, implementation settings and user-study procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond v2's weighting-function and FreeU sensitivity studies, v3 adds convergence diagnostics against IN2N and PDS and a controlled examination of FreeU on PDS (Appendix D, Table 5, Figures 12–14). These substantially extend the analyses testing optimization efficiency and whether FreeU alone explains the advantages.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same 95% confidence intervals around fitted regression lines in Figure 5. v3 adds no seed counts, repeated-run information, significance tests or uncertainty estimates for the new ablation and convergence results.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 retain their numerical values. New Table 5 reports PDS with FreeU at 0.162 CLIP directional similarity, 0.668 image similarity and 5.413 aesthetic score, versus 0.161, 0.687 and 5.437 without FreeU. Additional figures report convergence trajectories and qualitative comparisons; these are added findings, not improved DreamCatalyst scores between versions.

T1.justification: The DDS–SDEdit derivation, mathematical objectives, weighting definitions and design conditions are retained. Several equations become inline or are renumbered. Removing v2's explicit chain-rule gradient display, Equation 19, leaves the objective and stated Jacobian omission unchanged and does not revise the mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: the DDS–SDEdit interpretation, controllable weighting, FreeU integration and fast, high-quality editing across NeRF and 3DGS. The approximately 23-fold and eightfold speedup claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: v3 explains why FreeU can worsen PDS identity preservation and why its effect depends on the underlying method (Appendix D.2). Appendix F.2 also qualifies the existing weighting discussion with occasional background saturation attributed to excessive editability at small timesteps. The previous IP2P limitation is retained.

D1.justification: The new reproducibility statement explicitly says the previously linked repository provides setup information and datasets as well as source code. The added PDS experiment documents b = 1.1. Appendix B's existing implementation and hardware details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a new resource release.

R1.justification: The reference lists contain the same works, and the relationships to DDS, PDS, DreamSampler and FreeU remain substantively unchanged. The added comparisons reinforce the existing positioning.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording edits, expands explanations in Section 3, adds acknowledgements and a reproducibility statement, and inserts an additional quantitative-evaluation appendix. Most prose and the main narrative structure are retained. New Appendix C.2 incorrectly describes a skull edit where Figure 7 shows a mustache.

P2.justification: v3 adds Figures 7 and 12–14 and Table 5, clarifies FreeU condition labels in Table 4 and Figure 11, and adjusts table sizing and emphasis. Existing illustrations are retained, with appendix displays relocated or renumbered; equation highlighting and citation colors also change.

improvement.justification: The convergence comparisons and PDS-with-FreeU control strengthen evidence for the existing efficiency and component claims, while the expanded artifact discussion improves interpretation. These are useful additions to an otherwise stable method and benchmark evaluation. The new skull/mustache mismatch in Appendix C.2 and Figure 7 is a small reporting defect that does not outweigh the added validation.
